description: This file declares the AudioTimeStretcher class, which buffers and transforms audio data using the WSOLA algorithm for time stretching or compression, with methods for initialization, buffering, and processing audio frames.

classes.name: AudioTimeStretcher
classes.description: A class that buffers and processes audio data for time stretching or compression using WSOLA.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the object with audio stream information.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves scaled audio data based on playback rate.

methods.name: EnqueueBuffer
methods.description: Adds new audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: IsQueueFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is at or exceeds capacity.

methods.name: frames_buffered
methods.description: Returns the number of frames currently buffered.
